//: Installed plugins are copied into a version-pinned cache, so ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} has no path back to the checkout it came from - which is why this runs the published package rather than a relative script. That package carries stack.yaml and the sharded indexes, so the dependency lookups work on a machine that has never seen this repository. The documentation and authoring tools need the repository itself; open it in Claude Code and the .mcp.json at its root registers every group, the workspace graph included. No count is written here; it said twenty-two while the server registered twenty-four.

sushindustries-graph.//: The same repository as a graph, over the network rather than off a checkout. Ten named operations become ten tools - a tool is a question somebody decided was worth asking, where an open GraphQL endpoint is every question at once including the ones that return a hundred thousand tokens. Needs the `apollo-mcp-server` binary and MCP_AUTH_TOKEN; without either it simply does not start, and the stdio server above still answers.
